title: Rotor design and testing
description: Selected airfoil profile for efficient blade design
Calculated velocity triangles and aerodynamic forces for incoming wind and rotational speeds
Built Python script implementing BEM theory to compute induction factors and blade twist angles
Designed 2-bladed rotor template with optimal twist angles and chord distribution constrained by wood size
Drew chord curve directly on balsa wood and cut out blade shape with saw
Carved airfoil profile using cardboard templates at maximum chord location
Sanded blades to final thickness (3mm tip) to achieve target thickness-to-chord ratio
Assembled 2-bladed rotor on test tower with force transducer and laser RPM sensor (tachometer) and torque measurement scale
Tested at 3 m/s wind speed, and measured thrust, torque, RPM, and calculated power coefficient

title: Heat Storage
description: Designed thermal energy storage system using phase-change paraffin wax (melting at 58°C)
Optimized energy density per volume and weight within constraints
Calculated heat transfer through conduction, convection, and radiation
Built cylindrical storage: inner aluminum can with water/resistors, outer can with paraffin wax
Insulated with 10cm Rockwool (low thermal conductivity) and reflective aluminum foil
Designed electrical heating system: two 10Ω resistors in series, powered at 137A to reach 63°C
Instrumented with temperature sensors inside water, wax, exterior, and ambient
Built a python simulation with Euler's method to model cooldown process
Tested in lab: measured 48-hour heat retention, isothermal phase-change plateau at 57°C
Compared experimental data to theoretical model, achieving good correlation with adjusted convection coefficients
Identified optimal usage: heat to just above melting point, extract energy within 10 hours

title: Projection of Thermal Images Onto 3D Turbine Blade Surfaces
description: Implemented ITS Infrared Image Analyzer to project 2D images onto 3D blades
Applied pinhole camera model for Focal Plane Array infrared cameras
Calibrated matrix with Direct Linear Transform and Singular Value Decomposition methods
Used Genetic Algorithm with elitism/mutation and lambda strategies to minimize reprojection error
Selected intelligent points: cooling channel edges despite manufacturing tolerances
Processed thermal images with temperature adjustment and FFT filters for visibility
Generated 3D points in Siemens NX CAD software
ParaView Validation: <4mm camera position error
Successfully projected 5/8 angles (top, leading edge, mid, tip, trailing): 20-50 points per image
Analyzed challenges on suction side/trailing edge, cooling effectiveness and thermal hotspots
Proposed heating thermocouples for better visibility and improved projection accuracy

title: Swingwheel Design
description: Derived dynamic model from torque balance and rotational inertia
Implemented numerical solution using Euler's method in Python
Built hollow concrete cylinder flywheel prototype (5.3kg, I=3.11 kgm²)
Measured angular acceleration via encoder during controlled drop tests
Calibrated model against experimental data for system validation
Analyzed tensile stress limits: σ = ρ ω² r² for material selection
Scaled to carbon fiber: 60kg flywheel targeting 15-30k RPM operation
Optimized inertia with maximum peripheral mass distribution
Evaluated bearing friction impact: μ mg r_stang on deceleration
Quantified prototype energy storage: E = ½ I ω² capability
Assessed failure modes: centrifugal forces and structural integrity
Validated scaling: bus-sized steel/carbon designs for 500Wh storage

title: BSc Project Report: Dynamic shear profile modeling and validation with LiDAR data
description: Developed real-time shear profile estimation
Derived longitudinal velocity from LOS
Implemented rolling window filtering: spatial-temporal wind profiling
Applied Taylor's frozen turbulence hypothesis for advection correction
Fitted mathematical models to shear profiles
Generated synthetic lidar data with HAWC2 and Mann turbulence model
Validated algorithm on DTU 10MW turbine
Tested on time-varying shear and wind ramps
Analyzed lidar beam configurations
Quantified volume-averaging effects on pulsed lidar measurements
Proposed controller integration for fatigue load mitigation

title: Transformer Design
description: Designed cost-optimized 58 kVA single-phase distribution transformer
Optimized volts/turn, peak flux density Bc=1.8 T, current density
Selected M1000-50 silicon steel core and aluminum windings
Calculated core reluctance with 2 mm interleaved air gaps
Derived leakage inductance from winding geometry factors
Built equivalent circuit: magnetizing Xm=670 Ω, core loss Rc
Limited short-circuit current to <3×Inom via impedance tuning
Automated optimization via Python iteration over parameters
Voltage regulation: 5.22% (PF=1), up to 20.37% (PF=0 lagging)
Final design: 265 kg, 1.02 m³, 260 kg/m³ density, air-cooled
Compared to commercial 60 kVA unit: competitive size/weight

title: IoT Micro-controller Design Project: Energy Management with Embedded Systems
description: Developed Arduino MKR WiFi 1010 indoor climate control system
Implemented PWM for LED lighting (3 channels, 220Ω resistors)
Controlled DC heater motor via MOSFET + flyback diode
Automated servo-driven window actuator for ventilation
Integrated DHT22 temperature + photoresistor light sensors
Programmed timetable-based automation: 6-21h temp/light mgmt
Added thermostat override + gradual 30min LED wakeup routine
Used millis() for non-blocking multitasking (no delays)
Implemented SAMDTimerInterrupt for precise 2.3s ISR timing
Deployed Arduino IoT Cloud dashboard for remote monitoring
Displayed real-time T°/light/time/window status on LCD

title: Drive Train Control of a Grid Connected Wind Turbine with AFE, VOC, FOC and Microgrid Characterization: An Experimental Approach
description: Implemented DFOC on SCIG wind turbine generator for MPPT
Developed VOC on AFE converter for grid synchronization
Applied Clarke/Park transforms to control current
Estimated rotor flux/slip via Lm, τr dynamic model
Tuned PI controllers to decouple flux & torque
Built PLL DSOGI to estimate grid frequency
Estiamted SCIG inertia via ROCOF step-load tests
Measured droop response to various power loads
Calibrated Rogowski coils for 50kHz logging
Built Simulink models for dSpace/MicroLabBox hardware
